samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by fractional values. It generates a clock signal with a fractional frequency division (3.5x), using the double-edge clocking technique to achieve half-integer division while adjusting for duty cycle imbalance. By dividing uneven clock cycles and phase-shifting them, a smooth fractional clock output is produced.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Fractionally divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="MUL2_DIV_CLK">7</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF">3</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF_M1">2</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF_M2">4</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF_M3">6</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF_M4">5</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF_M5">1</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF_M6">3</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_CLK_HALF_M7">0</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="count_next" width_description="[3:0]">Next value of the counter.</signal>
        <signal id="div_clk" width_description="[1:0]">Intermediate divided clock signal.</signal>
        <signal id="div_clk_half" width_description="[1:0]">Phase-shifted divided clock signal.</signal>
        <signal id="div_clk_half_m1" width_description="[1:0]">First phase-shifted divided clock signal.</signal>
        <signal id="div_clk_half_m2" width_description="[1:0]">Second phase-shifted divided clock signal.</signal>
